context: A boss mentors a uni intern
purpose: Teach: 炭素/載る/初年度/下見/即決/補っ/ルポ/用例

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、炭素管理、企業の社会的責任の核だ。
lines.en: Ren — carbon management is the core of corporate social responsibility.
lines.style: Calm, direct opening. Lean forward slightly as he settles into teaching mode. Measured pace. Weight on 「核だ」 — this matters. Not lecturing: anchoring.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。記事が新聞に載ると、業界の注目度、上がりますね。
lines.en: Yes. When press coverage runs, it raises the industry's attention significantly.
lines.style: Eager but careful — wanting to show he understands without over-reaching. Slight uptick in energy. Respectful waiting-for-approval underneath the keenness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 初年度のレポート、若手が書くと、新鮮な視点が出る。
lines.en: When younger staff write first-year reports, fresh perspectives come through.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact observation. Slight nod in the delivery — recognising Ren's potential without spelling it out. Warm but sparing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 現場下見、私も同行できますか。
lines.en: May I accompany the site visit?
lines.style: Respectful but direct. Doesn't hedge — the question is simple and genuine. Slight lean into it, wanting to learn. Brief pause before speaking, gathering courage.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: うん。即決の習慣、現場で学べ。
lines.en: Yes. Learn the habit of making quick decisions on site.
lines.style: Affirming nod in the voice. Brief, definitive. Quiet confidence — this is permission and assignment wrapped together. Not stern, just assured.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: チームに欠員あれば、補ってもらえるんでしょうか。
lines.en: If there are openings on the team, will I be able to fill them?
lines.style: Careful framing — not presumptuous, but asking directly. Slight hesitation at the start, then steadier. Looking for clarity about his role and limits.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ルポ記事の用例、教材として渡すぞ。
lines.en: I'll pass along reportage examples as study material for you.
lines.style: Practical, closing gesture. Slight warmth under the efficiency — this is care, just measured and quiet. Decisive. Eyes steady.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。
lines.style: Genuine gratitude with small bow in the voice. Quiet, sincere. Not effusive — respects the moment. Holds the weight of what's been offered.
